title: Bad assert usage
body:
In core/group.py

Line 414:
``    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> GroupMetadata:
        data = dict(data)

        assert data.pop("node_type", None) in ("group", None)``

If code is run with -O it does not work correctly

comments.author: d-v-b
comments.text: I agree, it is bad. happy to review a PR that fixes it
